name: The Gilded Court
description: A Renaissance-inspired city-state where noble houses play deadly games of intrigue. Art, poison, and ambition flow in equal measure.
seed_prompt: The Gilded Court - a Renaissance city-state where noble houses scheme for power through art, assassination, and arranged marriages
lore_content:
The Gilded Court of Valdris stands as a beacon of culture and treachery in equal measure. Within its marble halls, five great houses vie for influence over the aging Duke Marcello.

Lord Aldric Ravencrest is the calculating patriarch of House Ravencrest. Cold and methodical, he prefers manipulation over direct confrontation. His patience is legendary - he has waited twenty years to avenge a slight against his family. Despite his ruthless reputation, he shows genuine kindness to artists and scholars who seek his patronage. He is known for his love of strategy games and his ability to remain calm under pressure.

Lady Seraphina Ashford leads House Ashford with charm and grace. Warm and charismatic, she draws people to her like moths to flame. Her silver tongue has resolved more conflicts than any sword. Yet beneath her warm exterior lurks a vengeful heart - those who betray her trust discover too late that her kindness has limits. She is impulsive when angered and fiercely protective of her children.

Captain Thorne Blackwood serves as the master-at-arms for the Duke's guard. A man of few words, his loyalty is absolute. He follows orders without question but struggles with the moral compromises his position demands. His fear of failure drives him to obsessive preparation. Veterans speak of his bravery in battle, where he becomes almost recklessly bold.

Maestra Elara Nightingale is the court's most celebrated artist and secret spymaster. Open to new ideas and experiences, she collects secrets as eagerly as she collects beautiful things. Her curious nature makes her an excellent gatherer of intelligence. She can be scattered and disorganized, jumping from project to project, but her creative genius is undeniable.

The Shadow - nobody knows their true identity. They leave roses at the scenes of their assassinations. Cold, methodical, showing no mercy to their targets yet adhering to a strict code: never harm the innocent, always honor a contract. Some say the Shadow was once a noble themselves, betrayed and left for dead.

The Golden Serpent Tavern serves as neutral ground where all factions meet. Its proprietor, Old Marco, has dirt on everyone and sells information to the highest bidder. Despite his mercenary nature, he maintains absolute discretion - his word is his bond, for without trust, his business would collapse.

The Temple of the Veiled Lady offers sanctuary to those fleeing persecution. High Priestess Celeste is patient and forgiving, believing in redemption for all. Her genuine compassion has saved many souls, though cynics suspect the temple gathers secrets of its own.

Beneath the gleaming spires, the Undercity festers. The Rat King commands the thieves' guild with brutal efficiency. Aggressive and territorial, he rules through fear and violence. Yet he remembers every slight and every favor - his long memory makes him a dangerous enemy and an invaluable ally.
